title: Abelian derived Homology sections comparison
statement: Let S be a scheme, q an integer and K a bounded-below derived complex of abelian etale sheaves on S. Let Z[U] be the sheafification of the free abelian group on the universe-lifted representable of U. The presheaf U↦Hom(Z[U][0],K[q]) has a natural locally surjective map τ to H^q(K). For every U and z, τ_U(z) is obtained by applying zeroth homology to z, using the degree-zero single-complex comparison and the homology shift comparison, and evaluating at the sheafified identity generator of Z[U].

source.place: Local cycle representatives and sheafification of derived cohomology; Tag 03Q8.

proof.text: Use the proved derived-Hom-to-homology local bijectivity on K shifted by q. Compose its map with freeSheafSections and the homology shift isomorphism. Local surjectivity is preserved by these isomorphisms; the specified generator formula is reflexivity.

theorem exists_abelianDerivedHomology_sections_comparison (S : Scheme.{u}) (q : ℤ)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    ∃ τ : (abelianComparisonFree S ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).op ⋙
        preadditiveYoneda.obj (K⟦q⟧) ⟶
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K).obj,
      Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective S.smallEtaleTopology τ ∧
      ∀ (U : S.Etale) (z : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((abelianComparisonFree S).obj U) ⟶ K⟦q⟧),
        τ.app (op U) z =
          (((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso 0).inv.app _ ≫
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).map z ≫
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).shiftIso q 0 q
              (add_zero q)).hom.app K).hom.app (op U))
            (((toSheafify S.smallEtaleTopology
              (uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj U ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op U))
                (FreeAbelianGroup.of (ULift.up (𝟙 U))))
